Reference image 2 shows the main picture of this same event: copy this EXACT machine - the tall post with the small shelf at the upper left holding the dark-blue cloth bundle and the small wooden box, the plank rising from the lower right to the upper left, the central gear axle, the black iron brackets, the round wooden floor, the carved paw print and the railing. The bundle and the box stay up on the shelf.
Reference image 3 shows another result picture of this same event: the same machine again, to confirm the angle, the gear axle, the iron brackets and the railing. Take only the machine - not the bundle and box on the floor; in the new picture they stay up on the shelf.
SCENE: SETTING exactly as in reference images 2 and 3, the SAME machine seen from the same angle: a round wooden plank platform floor; a giant wooden seesaw plank with black iron corner brackets, resting on a big central gear axle on a wooden stand; the plank's HIGH end rises to the UPPER LEFT and rests right beside a small wooden shelf fixed on top of a tall wooden post at the left; the plank's LOW end rests on the floor at the lower RIGHT, where a cat paw print is carved into the floor; a short wooden railing with round-knobbed posts runs behind the gear. Keep the plank tilted exactly this way (high on the left at the shelf, low on the right) - it is NOT a level playground seesaw: no seats, no handles, no seat boxes on its ends. The dark-blue tied cloth bundle and the small wooden box still sit up on the shelf on top of the post, untouched, as in reference image 2. The character's eyes look at the page.
Only the characters named in the SCENE appear - no other cats, no extra copies of anyone. No text, no letters, no numbers, no writing of any kind (drawings on paper are simple ink pictures, never words), no speech bubbles, no frame, no border. Truly transparent RGBA background: no checkerboard drawing, no white box, no wall or sky filling the frame, no cast shadow outside the small floor patch. The whole scene is centred with a clear transparent margin on every side; nothing is cut off at the edges.
